title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
This record is paper only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. The engines' own state, read from the running record, shows what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.

## Paper framing and live starts

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, a losing majority of trades occurred and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions

At the snapshot, htf-rsi-v007 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v005 shows 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 shows 0 positions open on paper. The record also lists a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. Because every position here is paper, these states describe simulated exposure rather than live capital. A zero count means no simulated position is currently held in that engine; it does not by itself explain why the count is zero.

## Closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 has 5 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The ATOM trade is one closed example: entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, exit below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, for −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A single closed trade records what happened to that signal; it does not establish a durable property of the engine.

## Market filter state

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. The record does not state a filter condition for htf-rsi-v007. With the filter off, the engines still report closed-trade averages and distances to breakout levels, but the snapshot shows 0 positions open in both trend engines. The closest names to their 20-day breakout in trend-daily-v005 are TRXUSDT, 12.57% below its high; AAVEUSDT, 16.30% below its high; and XLMUSDT, 17.87% below its high. In trend-daily-v006, the closest are JUPUSDT, 6.80% below its high; TRXUSDT, 12.57% below its high; and AAVEUSDT, 16.30% below its high. These distances are measurements from the snapshot, not targets or forecasts.

## Reading the record

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-18T03:20:03.316Z. The record updates continuously, so the counts, averages, filter states, and distances can change as new closes are processed. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Reporting the record as it stands means listing paper states and measured outcomes without projecting what comes next.
